notes.title: Patch note 1.3
notes.notes:
Below are the fixes and additions in patch 1.3:

Added Hard Mode and its related achievement

Added Easter eggs and related achievements

Added Old Game mode

Fixed issues on monitors with non-16:9 aspect ratios

Minor fixes to hitboxes, menus, and more
